title: 12 Best Jazz Bars in Cartagena
description: Discover Cartagena's top jazz bars for an unforgettable night of live music, delicious cocktails, and vibrant atmosphere. From Cuban son to modern jazz, find your perfect spot.

places.name: Cafe Havana
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Mojito Clásico (classic mojito) or a Cuba Libre, soak in the live music.

places.name: La Vitrola
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The seafood dishes are outstanding; pair your meal with a crisp white wine or a premium rum.

places.name: Juan del Mar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Any of their fresh seafood pasta dishes or a wood-fired pizza, accompanied by a local beer or cocktail.

places.name: El Barón
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their signature cocktails are a must-try; the 'El Barón' or a customized classic like an Old Fashioned.

places.name: Bar Cartagena (Hotel Charleston Santa Teresa)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A classic martini or a premium gin and tonic, paired with their selection of bar snacks.

places.name: Alquímico
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order One of their innovative, award-winning craft cocktails, such as 'Elixir de la Vida' or a seasonal creation.

places.name: Sibaris
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A selection from their extensive wine list, perhaps a local Colombian wine or a Spanish tempranillo, paired with a cheese and charcuterie board.

places.name: Pimienta Cocteleria
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask the bartender for a personalized cocktail recommendation based on your preferences or try their 'Ajiaco Sour'.

places.name: La Cevicheria
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Any of their ceviches are a must-try, especially the 'Ceviche Mixto'. Pair it with a cold Colombian beer or a refreshing sangria.

places.name: Bars around Plaza de San Diego
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Grab a table at any of the outdoor restaurants, order a Club Colombia beer or a simple cocktail, and enjoy the ambient music and street performances.

places.name: Bar El Zaguan (Sofitel Legend Santa Clara)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A classic cocktail expertly prepared or a glass of fine wine from their selection.

places.name: Malagana Café & Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Arepa de Huevo' (with a twist) or a 'Posta Negra Cartagenera', paired with a local craft beer or their house cocktail.
